notes.title: Important Language Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43294093/9811160f312e9ae8de11ccc890b80ffe1f4df902.png[/img]

We're finally submitting our game build for approval, which means that we aren't allowed to mark any languages as "available" if they're not included in the current build. Since we're still in the process of preparing the translations before release, we'll have to uncheck them during this approval process... [b]but worry not, we'll add them back later![/b] ❤️

The team is working really hard to try and bring Mr. Saitou to as many people as possible! So I wanted to let folks know which translation projects we're estimating will be finished in time for launch vs. ones that we'll roll out later on once they're completed.

[u]Languages that will most likely be available launch:[/u]
Chinese (Simplified)
French
Italian
Japanese
Korean
Portuguese (Brazil)
Russian
Spanish
Ukrainian
Vietnamese

[u]Languages that are being worked on, but won't be available at launch:[/u]
Chinese (Traditional)
Dutch
Lithuanian
Turkish

*If you'd like to translate Mr. Saitou into your language (we're especially looking for native German speakers), please send an email to shigiteam@gmail.com with a link to your Steam profile and which language you'd like to help with! Please only email if you're a native speaker of the language you'd be working on (i.e. you wouldn't be using Google Translate).

Thanks so much for your support, we really hope that you enjoy Mr. Saitou!

notes.title: 🎵 Developer Laura Shigihara Live-Streams Mr. Saitou #2 🎵
notes.content:
🌳 Hi folks! Laura here (Mr. Saitou/Rakuen developer)! I'm gonna be doing a [b]Steam Live-Stream February 7th, 2023 @ 7pm Pacific![/b] I'll be playing through the Mr. Saitou demo so that you can get a feel for the game. We'll also be doing a bit of Q&A, so folks can ask about things like Rakuen & Mr. Saitou, game development, composing music for video games, working in RPG Maker, and stuff like that! 

🌳 Maybe there will even be a bit of live music... 👀  I hope to see you there!
